title: Lilac flower tea - summer cottage
en: making lilac tea is a treat that I look forward to all year i watch with anticipation waiting for when the blooms are just ready for harvesting we have an abundance of herbs and flowers available to us that can be made into delicious tea you can usually grow your own herbs and flowers from seed but you can also purchase them at your local nursery separating the sweet blossoms from the more bitter stems is a time-consuming process I often think of it as a sort of labor a meditation in teaching me how to be patient and thoughtful and in the present after the tea is brewed for a few

minutes I usually add something to give the cup a little bit of sweetness the first sip of tea is always the most satisfying I love the taste and smell it is always worth the effort to put love and patience into everything you do the end result is that much better of course there's nothing like a freshly brewed cup of tea to inspire your creativity I always find myself painting with a cup next to my hand I'll see you guys next time I upload videos every Wednesday if you enjoyed this consider subscribing thank you
zh: 制作紫丁香茶是我全年期待的一种享受，我满怀期待地等待着花朵刚刚准备好收获的时候，我们有大量的药草和鲜花可供我们使用，可以制成美味的茶，您通常可以从种子中种植自己的药草和鲜花，但您也可以在当地的苗圃购买它们，将甜美的花朵与更苦的茎分开是一个耗时的过程，我经常将其视为一种劳动，一种冥想，教我如何耐心和体贴，并在生活结束后的当下茶是为几个人泡的
分钟 我通常会添加一些东西给杯子一点点甜味 第一口茶总是最令人满意的 我喜欢它的味道和气味 它总是值得付出努力 将爱和耐心投入到你所做的每件事中 最终的结果是更好 当然，没有什么比一杯现泡的茶更能激发你的创造力 我总是发现自己用手边的杯子画画 我下次每周三上传视频时见 如果你喜欢这个考虑订阅谢谢
